record.question: In the nineteenth century there was a phenomenal increase of pressure of population on land because:
options: The introduction of commercial crops attracted the peasantry to agriculture
The ruin of handicrafts and village industries drove the population to agriculture
The fall of the native governments had to reduced the avenues of employment
The urban population began to migrate to the rural areas for security reasons
record.explanation: The ruin of handicrafts drove population into agriculture.
